message:
Add three Lai'tela Overclocks, a x1 power and a Time Flow mode

New Overclocks, all bought with Reality Machines once Lai'tela unlocks:
- Entropy Catalyst (1e60): inside Lai'tela's Reality, Entropy and
  destabilization use a 10x smaller antimatter exponent (up to x100
  Entropy gain) and the Entropy gain cap is x10 higher.
- Void Harvest (1e70): squares Lai'tela's Dark Matter and Dark Energy
  Reality rewards, everywhere.
- Continuum Overdrive (1e80): inside Lai'tela's Reality, Continuum gives
  AD/ID/TD x(3 + destabilized Dimensions) purchases.

Ids above 32 are stored in new upgradeBitsHigh fields.

Overclock gets a Normal x1 power setting and a Time Flow button
(ON / OFF in Lai'tela / OFF). With Time Flow off, time runs normally
but every stat boost still applies. The Glyph and Hadron solvers use
the Lai'tela Time Flow for their Lai'tela phases.
